texts.facts: Vide this judgment, this court shall dispose of the present 16:31:45 +0530 case u/s 420 IPC r/w 63/65 Copyright Act and 78/79 Trademark Act. 2. The story of the prosecution is that on 14.06.2003 at 02:30 PM, at B-1721, Shastri Nagar, Delhi, within the jurisdiction of PS Sarai Rohilla, accused Rajpal was found in possession of duplicate/spurious gas regulators as well as packing material as detailed in the seizure memo Mark A and B of M/s Indian Oil Corporation and M/s Bharat Gas and further more raw material as well as the machinery used for the purpose of manufacturing of the said duplicate/spurious products were also recovered from the second floor of the aforesaid premises and one pressure dye casting machine, which was used in printing the duplicate hallmarks of Indian Oil Corporation gas regulators were also recovered from the possession of the accused and further the accused also sold one duplicate/spurious gas regulator to the decoy customer Ct. Joginder Singh for Rs. 500/- and thus he also cheated the decoy customer and the accused was also possessing the above duplicate/spurious gas regulator for the purpose of selling the same and thus infringed copyright of M/S Indian Oil Corporation Ltd. and M/S Bharat Gas Ltd. Secondly, on the aforesaid date, time and place the accused was found selling the aforesaid gas regulator, which were having falsified trademark of M/S Indian Oil Corporation and M/S Bharat Gas and thereby the accused committed an offence punishable u/s 420 IPC r/w 63/65 Copyright Act 1957 and 78/79 TMM Act and within the cognizance of this court. 3.
